title: Smart Thermostats: What to Know and What They Pay
desc: What to check before you buy a smart thermostat, and every open thermostat rebate we track, with the official page and the date we checked each one.
lead: A smart thermostat lets you set your heat from your phone. Here is what to check before you buy, and which programs pay today.
image_alt: A finger adjusting a digital thermostat on a wall
intro:
A smart thermostat controls your heating and cooling on a schedule, and you can change it from your phone. Rebates on these are usually small, but they are some of the easiest to claim.

The rules depend on how your home is heated. A thermostat for a gas furnace is not the same as one for electric baseboard heaters, which run on a higher voltage. Programs list the models they accept, and some give the thermostat away free to homes that qualify. Read the program page before you buy, so you buy the right type.
checks: How you heat. Gas and electric baseboard homes need different thermostats. Check that the model fits your system.
The model list. Programs pay for specific brands and models. Check the list before you shop.
Where you buy. Some rebates are instant at the checkout. Others need a receipt uploaded within a set time.
Free offers. Some utilities send a free thermostat to homes that qualify. Look before you buy one.
One per home. Many programs allow a set number per home, or only a first thermostat.
faq: Will a smart thermostat save me money?
It can, if you use its schedule. Savings depend on your home and how you heat it. Some utilities also pay you to let them adjust it at peak times.
Does it work with electric baseboard heaters?
Only with a thermostat made for line voltage. A regular smart thermostat can be a poor fit, so check the model.
Do I have to install it myself?
Many people do. Some programs need a pro for certain systems. The program page says.
